title: voc/v1 body
description: A VOC (voice of the customer) note: one Markdown document stored verbatim, the same shape as a domain-skill — `name` is the document id, `markdown` the author's text, `# <name>` by convention its first line. akg reads no section structure inside it; the only thing it takes from the text is its [[ ]] links (src/wikilinks.mjs). Rendered as-is to rendered/voc/<name>/VOC.md.

markdown.description: The whole note as the author wrote it, stored and rendered byte-for-byte.
